known_assets: Map 1 still uses the existing Wikimedia Commons wall/floor/stone source materials.
Map 4 still reuses the warm stone re-grade for its world-anchored tunnel.
Map 5 v23 columns are procedural faceted cylinders with vertical dark-to-light violet shading; no image asset is used.
Map 5 v23 giant signs remain procedural props: long brown pole, large tan cardboard screen, dark backing and violet mark.
The Map 5 abyss/bridge treatment is procedural and adds no external dependency.
visuals/spaces-lab/assets/checker-grid.svg remains historical/optional and is not loaded by current runtime.
rule: Map 5 must read as a bridge over a precipice: columns emerge from darkness, and sign storage/transition is hidden by column occlusion rather than exposed as UI-like animation.
